The '''Great Western Sea''' was a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], not far from the [[Manarai Mountains]]. It was an artificial reservoir made during the construction of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] for the enjoyment of natives and tourists, and had many artificially created islands floating on it, used by tourists on holidays. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had a [[Darth Vader's Coruscant fortress retreat|meditation retreat]] along the shore that was later used by his son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The [[Emperor's Villa]] was also located along the shore.

Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Coruscant]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it became a [[Succession pool]].
